title: Kissed Snappy Dutch Fish Stew
description: A charred and snappy Dutch dish perfect for a sick day, featuring sea salt and coconut cream, this stew is low in calories and full of flavor. It is cooked in a hot pot vessel for a hearty and comforting meal.
instructions: Preheat the hot pot vessel to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fillets with sea salt and black pepper.
Add the garlic, onion, carrots, and potatoes to the hot pot vessel and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the fish stock, coconut cream, and lemon juice to the hot pot vessel and stir well.
Add the cod fillets to the hot pot vessel and cook for 10 minutes or until cooked through.
Stir the stew occasionally to prevent burning.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot and enjoy.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
